description: React component for managing and displaying installed OAuth applications in Mattermost, including loading data, sorting, filtering, and rendering OAuth app entries.

classes.name: InstalledOAuthApps
classes.description: React component class for displaying and managing OAuth applications within Mattermost.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes component state with loading set to true.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Loads OAuth apps and profiles if OAuth service provider is enabled.

methods.name: deleteOAuthApp
methods.description: Deletes an OAuth app given its OAuthApp object.

methods.name: oauthAppCompare
methods.description: Compares two OAuthApp objects by name for sorting.

methods.name: oauthApps
methods.description: Filters, sorts, and maps OAuth apps to React components.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the OAuth apps list with headers, help text, and search functionality.
